description: Authoritative GNSS availability and signal integrity status enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3.

definitions.HEALTHY: GNSS fix available with nominal constellation geometry, PDOP within threshold, and valid pseudorange residuals.
definitions.DEGRADED: GNSS fix available but degraded by multipath, elevated PDOP, or reduced satellite visibility.
definitions.UNAVAILABLE: GNSS fix lost, jammed, spoofed, or denied; signals unavailable for navigation aiding.
definitions.CANDIDATE_RETURN: First potential GNSS fix acquired post-outage, pending screening and dwell validation before re-aiding.
